$comment: Committed targets: the end-state each subsystem is designed against. Written for the v2 refactor (task T0.5; the plan is archived at .altitude/history/NEXT-GEN-UPGRADE-PLAN.md) and kept as the steady-state record. NOT machine-read — the only references to this file anywhere in the repo are two doc pointers, the `Pinned target versions` row of AGENTS.md's "Where to look for things" table and CLAUDE.md's "Plan + status" section (`grep -rn targets.json scripts libs apps .github`). An earlier version of this comment claimed scripts read it; they do not, and it cited line numbers that have since moved. It is a HUMAN/AGENT contract, so drift between it and reality is invisible to CI and must be corrected by hand — every value below should be re-derivable from a file cited in `rationale`.

rationale.decoratorMode: G7: never change build tooling and language semantics in the same step. Standard decorators are deferred to T7.1. WHERE IT IS ENFORCED: the setting that decides the SHIPPED semantics is esbuild's, not tsc's. As of the 2026-08-27 cleanup exactly ONE file sets it: libs/al-web-components/vite.config.mjs:119-123 (`experimentalDecorators: true` + `useDefineForClassFields: false`). This entry previously also cited vite.spike.config.mjs:44-45 and the two Storybook configs (al-web-components/.storybook/main.ts, al-react/.storybook/main.ts); Storybook was retired 2026-08-25 and the Vite-migration spike 2026-08-27, so none of those three paths exist any more. libs/al-web-components/tsconfig.json:21 sets only `useDefineForClassFields: false` and omits `experimentalDecorators`; that is deliberate and harmless because it is `emitDeclarationOnly: true` (it emits .d.ts, never JS) and the codebase uses `@property accessor` auto-accessors, which type-check identically in both decorator modes (verified 2026-08-23 by running `tsc --noEmit` with and without the flag: both exit 0). libs/al-react/tsconfig.json:56-57 does set both because it emits JS.
rationale.storybook: RETIRED 2026-08-25. Both Storybooks and their `.storybook/` directories were deleted; there is no successor component explorer. The isolated render surface is libs/al-web-components/story-fixture (root scripts `build:story-fixture`, `a11y:report:fixture`), the documentation surface is apps/docs, and the agent surface is the Altitude MCP on :6017 (`pnpm --filter @southleft/al-web-components start`). The retired `storybookBuilder` and `storybookTestRunner` rows were removed with it. Keep this row as a tombstone so the absence reads as a decision rather than an omission.
rationale.vite: Both libraries declare vite ^7.1.12 (libs/al-web-components/package.json, libs/al-react/package.json), verified 2026-09-02. This field read "5.x" until then, and README.md / CLAUDE.md repeated it — the three are corrected together.
rationale.packageManager: User-confirmed pnpm over yarn 4 (stricter dep graph catches phantom deps).
rationale.vrtTool: User-confirmed Playwright (free, in-repo, runs in CI).
rationale.pilotComponents: G3 pilot gate: 5 components prove every pattern end-to-end before scaling to ~65.
